subject: CNOVUS: Collaborative MAP + sprint timeline (initial draft)
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara@cloudnovus.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CNOVUS: Collaborative MAP + sprint timeline (initial draft)

Hi Tara —

Thanks for the sync today. As discussed, attached is our first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a parallel slide deck that breaks the pilot into a week-by-week sprint. The goal here is to give your team a concrete, time-boxed path to a production evaluation:

What I shared:
- MAP (Google Doc): joint milestones, owners, acceptance criteria
- Sprint slides (Google Slides): weekly checkpoints and tech/SE owners
- Requirements workbook (Excel): telemetry, data flow, and security asks

Asks from us:
1) Could you confirm the preferred tech kickoff week (we proposed Nov 3 — flexible)
2) Are there any additional compliance docs we should attach (SOC2 evidence, IP addendums)?
3) If procurement wants a separate doc, loop them in (I cc'd procurement alias)

Attachments: [CNOVUS_MAP_v1.gdoc], [CNOVUS_week-by-week_v1.gslides], [cnovus_requirements.xlsx]

Links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1abcCNOVUS_MAP (edit), https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/2defCNOVUS_SLIDES (view)

Next step: Marissa will seed the acceptance criteria section and Ben will add an observability requirement. We’ll circulate a revised MAP by EOD Thursday.

Thanks — look forward to your thoughts.

—
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | (415) 555-0172

From: Tara Singh <tara@cloudnovus.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@cloudnovus.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Oct 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CNOVUS: Collaborative MAP + sprint timeline (initial draft)

Thanks, Jasmine — this looks like a solid starting point. A few quick notes: 

- Can we shift the tech kickoff to the week of Nov 10 instead of Nov 3? That gives our infra team time to complete a short network review.
- For compliance: we will need SOC2 Type II evidence and a simple data retention clause in the MAP. Procurement will handle contract language but happy to see a short summary in the doc.
- Telemetry: we care most about request/response latency and per-model token usage metrics. We’ll add examples in the requirements workbook.

I’ll review the doc with my engineering lead tomorrow and get back with any edits. Procurement included — they’ll indicate the contracting timeline.

Best,
Tara
Head of Platform, CloudNovus

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara@cloudnovus.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Oct 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CNOVUS: Collaborative MAP + sprint timeline (initial draft)

Thanks for the quick reply, Tara — shifting to Nov 10 works for us. I updated the MAP to reflect that tentative kickoff and sketched a granular 6-week sprint in the slides. High-level changes I made: 

- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): access, test keys, VPC peering checklist (owner: CloudNovus)
- Week 1: infra smoke tests + sample prompts (owner: Redwood SE)
- Week 2: integration tests, KV cache validation (owner: CloudNovus Eng)
- Week 3: performance tuning + quantization profile test (owner: Redwood Runtime)
- Week 4: user acceptance testing + quality checks (owners: joint)
- Week 5: readiness review + rollback/fallback runbook (owner: Marissa)

Acceptance criteria (seeded in the doc):
- End-to-end latency <= 500ms p95 for the main inference path
- Token-cost per request within the agreed estimate (see workbook tab B)
- Error rate < 0.5% over 24h test window

I left inline comments where we need CloudNovus input (notably around expected scale and which endpoints will be production-critical). Ben — can you add an observability bullet for the tracing keys and an example Grafana panel for token-cost?

P.S. I added a short SOC2 checklist section for procurement to reference. Let me know if you want this formalized in a separate attachment.

—Marissa
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara@cloudnovus.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Oct 2025 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CNOVUS: Collaborative MAP + sprint timeline (initial draft)

Noted — I added a one-slide observability stub in the slides and a short telemetry table in the workbook. Key callouts I added: 
- Required tracing keys and sample spans (so CloudNovus can map Redwood traces into their APM)
- A minimal Grafana panel for p95 latency and token-count by model
- A fallback metric: model-fallback-rate (if Redwood runtime falls back to a smaller variant)

Attachment: [cnovus_requirements.xlsx] includes the telemetry sheet.

If CloudNovus can confirm the expected RPS and top inference paths, I can turn these into dashboards and a short runbook.

—Ben
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara@cloudnovus.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Oct 2025 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CNOVUS: Collaborative MAP + sprint timeline (initial draft)

Team — thanks for the edits. Quick summary and next steps: 

- Tech kickoff provisional week: Nov 10 (CloudNovus to confirm)
- Redwood to deliver revised MAP + slides with Ben/Marissa inputs by Mon Oct 27 EOD PST
- Procurement: we’ll add the SOC2 evidence link and a 30/60/90 data retention table in the doc for your review
- Action owners updated in the MAP (see Owner column)

Actions for CloudNovus (Tara / procurement):
- Confirm kickoff week (Nov 10 preferred)
- Share expected RPS and two primary inference endpoints for dashboarding
- Procurement to advise on contracting timeline (we’ll surface the SOC2 stub and data-retention table)

Attachments in next send: [CNOVUS_MAP_v1.gdoc - revised], [CNOVUS_week-by-week_v1.gslides - updated], [cnovus_requirements.xlsx - telemetry tab updated]

If there are no major changes, we’ll ask to lock the MAP by Nov 3 so engineering can schedule the kickoff. Thanks everyone — I’ll ping again once the updated files are live.

—
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | Redwood Inference
